# Qaroshi controlled dialogue practice

All content in this collection is synthetically generated as classroom practice. The 1,000 distinct lexeme/scenario pairs derive from a reusable twenty-six-turn learning arc; **these are not 1,000 independently authored natural conversations**. English is a gloss, not externally verified translation. No speaker recordings or dialect attestations are implied.

## CD0001: closed captions / colorblind

- **A:** hë ti kabango-m tika-te he?  
  Did you see closed captions?
- **B:** sen mi kabango-m tika-te si.  
  I saw closed captions myself.
- **A:** zher mi konishonë-m nu tika-te.  
  I did not see colorblind.
- **B:** sen mi konishonë-m tika-te hu.  
  I heard that colorblind was seen.
- **A:** hë ti konishonë-m tika-te si he?  
  Did you personally see colorblind?
- **B:** sen mi konishonë-m nu tika-te.  
  I did not personally see colorblind.
- **A:** sen mi kabango-m shiroli-yu.  
  I will write down closed captions.
- **B:** dal mi konishonë-m shiroli-yu.  
  I will document colorblind.
- **A:** hë ti kabango-m daru-ki he?  
  Can you protect closed captions?
- **B:** sen mi kabango-m daru-ki.  
  I can protect closed captions.
- **A:** hë ti konishonë-m daru-ho he?  
  Are you permitted to protect colorblind?
- **B:** sen mi konishonë-m daru-ho.  
  I am permitted to protect colorblind.
- **A:** zher mi kabango-m nu shiri-yu.  
  I will not speak about closed captions yet.
- **B:** më mi ti-m daru-yu.  
  I will protect you.
- **A:** hë ti kabango-m sharoa-yu he?  
  Will you ask about closed captions?
- **B:** sen mi kabango-m sharoa-yu.  
  I will ask about closed captions.
- **A:** më mi ti-wa nëra-yu.  
  I will stay with you.
- **B:** hol mi ti-m holë.  
  Thank you.
- **A:** sen mi konishonë-m tika-yu.  
  I will look for colorblind.
- **B:** dal mi konishonë-m daru-yu.  
  I will keep colorblind safe.
- **A:** hë ti-na mara kabango-m tika-te he?  
  Did your friend see closed captions?
- **B:** sen mi-na mara kabango-m tika-te hu.  
  I was told that my friend saw closed captions.
- **A:** zher mi-na mara konishonë-m nu tika-te ye.  
  I infer that my friend did not see colorblind.
- **B:** sen mi kabango-m shiroli-te si.  
  I personally wrote down closed captions.
- **A:** dal mi kabango-m daru-yu.  
  I will take responsibility for protecting closed captions.
- **B:** nëm mi ti-wa nëru-yu.  
  I will rest with you peacefully.
